label.zh: 注入星界丝缕：成功或胚胎解体

note.zh: 花 10 星界丝缕稳定胚胎后，本阶段要么突破孵出“曲跃雏”（2035），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败，胚胎解体（2030）；选择“不要干预”则直接进入 2030。
note.en: After spending 10 astral threads to stabilise the embryo the stage either breaks through and the Warpling hatches (2035) or fails on a roll, base 1.5% per roll, and the embryo disintegrates (2030); “Do not intervene” leads straight to 2030.

label.zh: 安乐死：阻止寄生虫外传

note.zh: 按防污染流程用盐酸处死全部标本；获得物理研究与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: All specimens are destroyed with acid under anti-contamination protocol; physics research and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 孵出能短距跃迁的战斗生物；可建造新型进攻部队“曲跃雏”，获得大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: A combat creature able to warp short distances hatches; the Warpling assault army becomes buildable and a large astral thread reward is granted; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 带回满是量子寄生虫的研究人员尸体（已用酸消毒）；获得大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: The researchers' parasite-ridden corpses are brought back (after acid decontamination); a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 探索结束、胚胎解体30天后，科学家因接触寄生虫“自爆”身亡。
note.en: 30 days after the embryo disintegrates and the exploration ends, the scientist dies, “spontaneously exploded”, from parasite exposure.

notes.zh: 无论是主动“不要干预”还是注入星界丝缕失败，进入 2030 后都会在 30 天后失去科学家（2045）；本篇先给物理研究与大量星界丝缕。
notes.en: Whether reached by “Do not intervene” or by a failed injection, 2030 costs the scientist 30 days later (2045); this event itself first grants physics research and a large astral thread reward.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 2000–2045 全部事件，补上 2020.b 的失败分支 2030，并核对 2030 在 30 天后触发的科学家死亡。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 2000–2045; added the failure fallback 2030 of 2020.b and verified the scientist's death 30 days after 2030.
